directAnswerSecondSentence: Selected files are processed locally in your browser; performance depends on browser support and available device memory.

faqs.question: Does {toolName} upload my files to a server?
faqs.answer: Document processing happens locally in your browser, and file contents are not sent to ClickPDF's document-processing servers. The website may still make standard network requests for page resources and enabled third-party services, such as ads.

faqs.question: Is {toolName} free, and is there a file-size limit?
faqs.answer: ClickPDF is free to use without an account, and it does not add a branding watermark by default. There is no single file-size limit for every tool; practical limits depend on the file, browser support, and available device memory. Watermark PDF adds a mark only when you choose to apply one.

faqs.question: Can I use {toolName} on Android, iPhone, and PC?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use a modern browser on Android, iPhone or iPad, or a desktop computer; supported features and performance vary with the browser and available device memory. No app installation is required.
